prompt: Strip the markers off a doc comment to recover its description, and pull out the summary sentence. Complete DocCommentCleaner and run the tests.
explanation: Stripping a doc comment is a fixed sequence of small edits per line, and doing them in the documented order is what makes a one-line comment like the opener-plus-text-plus-closer form work as well as a multi-line one. Blank star lines clean down to empty strings, so joining with spaces and then collapsing runs of spaces removes them without a special case. The summary sentence rule -- a period at the end or followed by a space -- is the same one the real javadoc tool uses.
hints: Write a private clean(line) helper that applies the five steps in the documented order; the order matters for a one-line comment.
Break out of the loop at the first cleaned line that starts with "@" rather than skipping tag lines individually.
After joining, text.replaceAll(" +", " ").trim() flattens the gaps left behind by blank star lines.
